name: What is the process for an exterior home makeover with a contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an exterior home makeover with a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically starts with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and desired outcomes. Following this, the contractor will conduct a site assessment to evaluate the current condition of your home and take measurements. A detailed proposal will then be provided, outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Once approved, permits are secured (if needed), and a project schedule is established. Construction then begins, managed by the contractor, with regular communication until project completion and final walk-through.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, site assessment, proposal, securing permits, construction, and a final walk-through.
